scope: read-only review of ordinary preprocessing code; not a new runtime experiment or proof of byte-identical full-scale regeneration
findings: wrapper creates a fresh input directory containing only one original.bin symlink, so filesystem multi-file enumeration order is not part of the input order
ApplyQSearch=true and PairedShuffle=false select ordinary40-byte PSV records; paired root/leaf sampling branch is disabled
qsearch runs in parallel on records indexed in the original batch; writing to random buckets is serial and preserves this index order before shuffling
mt19937_64 uses the specified nonzero ShuffleSeed; the same generator drives bucket assignment and each bucket shuffle
qsearch disables evaluation hash and transposition-table probing; each leaf stores MOVE_NONE and retains original score/result with sign adjusted to leaf side
existing512-position repeated-seed byte-identity test is empirical small-sample evidence; completed64m output is frozen by SHA, not claimed to have been regenerated independently at full scale
